posts.title: Diddy Kong Racing contains a track in its sound test (Number 12) that cannot actually be heard…
posts.description: Diddy Kong Racing contains a track in its sound test (Number 12) that cannot actually be heard in-game. According to the composer, David Wise, this was planned to be used for the Crescent Island course but was ultimately replaced with a different song.
